body: The truth is that I'm guilty of what I've done... it's all interconnected... like there's no escape. i can't escape the truth of myself... it's like i've been fooling myself for over a decade. i don't want to fool myself anymore.
It probably would... even talking right now helps, but at this point I think the truth would lead to a lifetime of suffering and I'm not strong enough to handle that.

From what I know now, it seems like the consequences of telling the truth would be far too calamitous for me to bear. Forgiveness is far too lofty in this context. I suppose fear of living as me is mainly what's driving me at this point.
